raw:
Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 18  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that P. J. O'Rourke was born first despite having clear evidence from prior steps that José Echegaray y Eizaguirre was born on April 19, 1832, and P. J. O'Rourke was born on November 14, 1947. The Planner failed to compare the two dates correctly, as 1832 is evidently earlier than 1947. This logical error directly led to the wrong solution to the real-world problem.
